cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. The manager signs at completion. Put the start time here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended pending your call; she'll need the delay against your name.
